edits.old: Then the service log records the role and the operation, never a personal field, and nothing is written
edits.new:
Then the service log records the role and the operation, never a personal field, and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC7 A status change the model does not allow is refused (X7)
    Given a case status change the model does not allow
    When the status change arrives on the case signal
    Then no rule fires and no treatment is opened
    Then nothing is written and the stage waits on the next signal

  Scenario: AC8 Call without valid credentials is refused with 401 (X1, X2; 403 and 404 are AC6 and AC5)
    Given a call to a provided operation without valid credentials
    When the operation is called
    Then the system answers 401 and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC9 Replay of a write with the same idempotency key (X5; BR8)
    Given a write has already been accepted under an Idempotency-Key
    When the same write arrives again with the same key
    Then the first answer is returned and the repeat is counted
    Then no second row, decision record or event is written

  Scenario: AC10 Activity retried or timed out (BR8; DP-03)
    Given an activity of the treatment workflow is retried or times out
    When the retry runs or the timeout is reached
    Then no second treatment row, decision record or outbox row is written
    Then the one transaction either completes or rolls back as a whole
